units.source_text: 正當我感到納悶時，覺得肚子十分難受，就急忙衝進了廁所，結果狂瀉不止地拉起了肚子，之後又連續三次跑進廁所。

en.t: While I was wondering what was wrong, my stomach began to feel terribly upset, so I rushed to the toilet, where I was seized by relentless diarrhea, and afterward I had to run there three more times.

units.source_text: 心中疑竇重重，拿起藥盒定睛一看，原來是一種叫海諾莫欽的瀉藥。

en.t: Full of suspicion, I picked up the medicine box and looked closely; it turned out to be a laxative called Henomochin.

units.source_text: 我仰臥在床，肚子上放了個熱水袋，想衝著徹子大發一頓牢騷。

en.t: I lay on my back in bed with a hot-water bottle on my stomach, intending to give Tetsuko a piece of my mind.

units.source_text: 「你買的藥不是卡爾莫欽，是海諾莫欽啊。」

en.t: “The medicine you bought was not Calmotin; it was Henomochin.”

units.source_text: 我剛一開口，便忍不住笑了起來。

en.t: The moment I began to say it, I could not help laughing.

units.source_text: 「廢人」，這的確像一個喜劇名詞。

en.t: “Ruined man” really does sound like a comic noun.

units.source_text: 想睡覺時，卻誤服了瀉藥，而且瀉藥的名字就叫海諾莫欽。

en.t: Trying to go to sleep, I had taken a laxative by mistake, and the laxative was even named Henomochin.

units.source_text: 對於現在的我，既沒有幸福，也沒有不幸。

en.t: For me now, there is neither happiness nor unhappiness.
